d: Long, flowing dusty-rose hair is styled with blunt bangs and a high ponytail secured by a gold dragon ornament. The narrow, sharp eyes are a pale grey, set upon a youthful and mature face. A slender build is dressed in a black sleeveless mini-dress with lace trim, worn over a deep-red long-sleeved collared shirt and topped with a flowing black overcoat featuring gold patterned lining. Accessories include sheer black thigh-high stockings with lace garters, black high-heeled pumps, and a long silver polearm with a black blade and a red decorative tassel.
